### Important RV limitation

Although the AC200L has a TT-30 outlet, its 2,400W inverter provides approximately **20 amps at 120V**, not a full 30 amps of RV shore power.

It is suitable for typical RV essentials such as a refrigerator, water pump, lights, electronics, and occasional coffee-maker use, subject to combined load. It is not a reliable solution for running a conventional rooftop RV air conditioner.

Also, turn off your RV converter when appropriate to avoid wasting power charging the house battery from the portable station.
